> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **4** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-defaults/data.json`, `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/field.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **7** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **56** of **208** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **149** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json cdb949a288e1bd3350f09527c5f2169eb4752c23` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `142e1d1b1bbc587f8b51baccf2a4f743d5ab5da5` — the merge of head `a7683e16f04b033a608a5bb8fdfe8cb03e3619ec` into base `cdb949a288e1bd3350f09527c5f2169eb4752c23`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 142e1d1b1bbc587f8b51baccf2a4f743d5ab5da5 && git checkout 142e1d1b1bbc587f8b51baccf2a4f743d5ab5da5
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin cdb949a288e1bd3350f09527c5f2169eb4752c23 a7683e16f04b033a608a5bb8fdfe8cb03e3619ec && git checkout -B drift-repro cdb949a288e1bd3350f09527c5f2169eb4752c23 && git merge --no-ff a7683e16f04b033a608a5bb8fdfe8cb03e3619ec

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json cdb949a288e1bd3350f09527c5f2169eb4752c23
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs cdb949a288e1bd3350f09527c5f2169eb4752c23` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

Base read as `origin/main` `91a4036a6a` (the PR body measured on `6866e2e7c`; the readings below agree on every cited line).

### ① Derived judgments

**The refusal.** `CurrencyConfigSchema` (`field.zod.ts`, head) drops `.default('CNY')` for `.optional()` and adds one `.superRefine(refuseFixedCurrencyWithoutCode)` inside the `lazySchema` lambda, so the check travels with the schema everywhere it is embedded. `{ currencyMode: 'fixed' }` answers one `custom` issue at `defaultCurrency` whose first sentence is the prescription (ISO 4217 code, or `dynamic` for the tenant default); the message carries no tracker number. `fixed` with a code round-trips byte-identical; `{}` and `{ currencyMode: 'dynamic' }` parse to `{ currencyMode: 'dynamic' }` with no `defaultCurrency` key; `parse(parse(x))` is pinned on the config and on `FieldSchema` for every accepted shape (`currency-config-fixed-code-required.test.ts`). Authoring doors: `objectstack build` and publish parse through `ObjectSchema` / the marketplace `manifest.objects.element.fields` shapes (the 13 new `currencyConfig` sites in `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` are exactly those embeddings, 252 schemas / 900 sites); the Studio field editor and every `/meta` write go through `saveMetaItem`, whose `resolveOverlaySchema('object')` is `ObjectSchema.safeParse` (422 with the issue). The `.describe()` reads "required under `fixed`"; the field form's help text and its four locale bundles say "Required in fixed mode; nothing fills one in"; `authorable-defaults/data.json` loses the `CNY` row. One door is not reached, as for every refinement on main: a raw programmatic `registry.registerObject(def)` runs only the field-`type` door (`registry.ts` `registerObject`, `objectFieldTypeRefusal`) and no `ObjectSchema` parse; pre-existing posture, not this PR's.

**The formula shape (#22727).** `FieldSchema.currencyConfig` is `CurrencyConfigSchema.optional()` once (`field.zod.ts` `currencyConfig:` row), read for a currency field and for `returnType: 'currency'`; the test pins the same `custom` issue at `currencyConfig.defaultCurrency` on both, and `formula-currency-result.test.ts` moves `{ currencyMode: 'fixed' }` from the accepted list to the malformed list. One refine, no copy.

**ADR-0087 conversions.** D2 `currency-config-dynamic-default-currency-removed`: `toMajor: 18`, `retiredFromLoadPath: true`, `retiredAfter: '18.2.0'` (the current stable label of `@objectstack/spec`, which is what `MetadataConversion.retiredAfter` is defined as), order 78 (unique; the step's previous maximum is 77, and `currency-config-precision-removed` at 41 runs first, which the re-pinned `currency-precision-iso4217.test.ts` depends on). It walks `objects` and `objectExtensions` fields, strips `defaultCurrency` only where `currencyMode` is absent or `'dynamic'`, and leaves a `fixed` config by reference; fixture pair with `expectedNotices: 3`; `applyConversionsToStoredItem` wraps a stored `object` row as `{ objects: [row] }` so the stored seam reaches it, pinned. D3 `currency-config-fixed-default-currency-required` links the D2 id; `STEP18_RATIONALE` order 112; `DEFAULT_CHANGES_BY_MAJOR[18]` declares `data/CurrencyConfig:defaultCurrency: "CNY" → (none)`. It is a key strip of an unread key, not a default-flip reinterpretation, so it owes no `DEFAULT_FLIPS_NOT_REPLAYED_HERE` row at the artifact door; built artifacts hold the parsed stack (`artifact-forward-conversion.ts` docblock), so an artifact's `fixed` config carries its baked code and its `dynamic` CNY is stripped inside the window (`floor <= 18.2.0`).

**A stored `fixed` row without a code CAN exist, and the PR declares it cannot.** `saveMetaItem` stores every type but `view` as the original payload verbatim with two grafts (`protocol.ts`, the `resolveOverlaySchema` docblock: "Every other type stores its original payload verbatim"; ADR-0005 appendix (c)). So a `sys_metadata` object row authored through Studio's composite (mode `Fixed`, code left blank) or a `/meta` write of `{ currencyMode: 'fixed' }` was accepted by the old schema and persisted WITHOUT a code; no parse baked `CNY` into it. The PR says the opposite in five places: the changeset body ("Every earlier parse baked the code in, so no stored `fixed` row lacks one"), the D3 `reason` ("no stored fixed row lacks one", projected into the upgrade guide), the `DEFAULT_CHANGES_BY_MAJOR[18]` `reason`, the registry docblock ("A `fixed` row is left alone: its code, authored or baked... satisfies the new refinement"), and `ui/packages/i18n/src/currency.ts` ("A `fixed` config now always carries its code"). What load actually does with such a row at this head: `convertStoredItem` leaves it (mode is `fixed`), `computeMetadataDiagnostics` fails it at `fields.*.currencyConfig.defaultCurrency`, `loadMetaFromDb` counts it `invalid`, prints `[metadata_spec_invalid]`, and registers the raw body with `_diagnostics`; a re-save in Studio is refused 422 with the prescription until the code is written. Display does not change for that row: the registry held the raw body before too, so `resolveFieldCurrency` (`currency.ts:60`, `||` chain) already fell through to the tenant default, and the analytics relay (`plugin.ts:1447`) relayed `undefined`; what changes is `@objectstack/formula`'s `currencyOf` for a formula over that field (fixed CNY → unproven, which the PR declares generally). This is consistent with ruling X (nothing is converted to `'CNY'`, nothing guesses), but the disposition the changeset and D3 entry ship is a false factual claim about data at rest, in the CHANGELOG text an upgrading agent greps and in the generated upgrade guide, and the real disposition (registered with diagnostics, refused on re-save, formula inference flips) is undeclared and unpinned.

**Readers of `defaultCurrency` on main, each measured.** `ui/packages/i18n/src/currency.ts:60` reads the code only under `currencyMode === 'fixed'` (display rule unchanged; its test now pins the empty config carries no code and still resolves to the tenant `USD`); every ui field, grid, dashboard and detail face reaches it through `resolveFieldCurrency` or passes `currencyConfig` through untouched (`useColumnSummary.ts:659`, `recordFields.tsx` `buildFieldMeta`, `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:805`, `fields/src/index.tsx:835`, `objectGridGenerateColumns.tsx`, `RecordDetailPanel.tsx`, `RelatedList.tsx`, `fieldEnrichment.ts`); `shared-record-shape.ts:122` is a type mirror. `packages/services/service-analytics/src/plugin.ts:1447` relays the code only under `fixed`; `analytics-service.ts:3167` reads that relay. `packages/types/src/share-link-resolve-answer.ts:120` copies the code when it is a string, so a dynamic projection loses a `CNY` key the console reads only under `fixed`. `packages/formula/src/formula-return.ts` `currencyOf` is the one changed reader, pinned by `fixed_no_code`. `plugin-email` has no `currencyConfig` reader (its currency is the template argument, G2 of the ruling); no lint rule reads the key; `packages/spec/src/api/analytics.zod.ts`, `contracts/analytics-service.ts`, `percent-scale.ts` are prose. No reader starts formatting in another currency or throws; the one that saw `'CNY'` and now sees `undefined` on a `dynamic` config (share-link projection) was already mode-gated at its consumer.

**Survey.** `git grep` over `origin/main` for every spelling of `currencyMode` = `fixed` (TS, JSON, YAML, the `mode:` alias) outside tests, CHANGELOGs and prose: examples 6 (`account.object.ts:65`, `field-zoo.object.ts:60`, `project.object.ts:71/77/88`, `semantic-zoo.object.ts:62`), `ui/examples/schema-catalog` 2 (`euro-currency.json`, `usd-currency.json`, code on the next line), `conversions/registry.ts` precision fixture 4; `packages/platform-objects/**` and `packages/qa/**` declare no currency field with a config (`field-zoo.matrix.ts:105` is a value check). Every hit carries a code: 0 `fixed` without a code, agreeing with the PR's 0. `Field.currency()` (`field.zod.ts:3137`) spreads the input and sets no mode, so no factory produces a bare `fixed`.

**Declarations.** Changeset `27157-currency-config-fixed-code-required.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, `@objectstack/formula` minor, `@objectstack/platform-objects` minor — `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` takes at least minor on each package the diff moves, pre-GA minor with the BREAKING banner per ADR-0087's 2026-09-13 level half; `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` on both body and changeset; marker `adr-0087: registered` naming both ids, both new in the diff (grammar per the 2026-08-13 addendum; `Check Changeset` success at 11:01:08Z). FROM → TO and the one-line fix present. Liveness `field.json` `currencyConfig` row: dated NARROWED note, verdict LIVE, reader re-cited. `Skills-docs: none` holds: `git grep CNY -- skills ui/skills .claude/skills` is 0 hits; `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md:174-187` and `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md:301` teach `defaultCurrency` only as an explicit code under `fixed`. `Fixes #27157` present. The two hand-written docs tables and the generated `references/data/field.mdx` drop "Defaults to CNY"; remaining `CNY` mentions under `content/docs` are unrelated (an email `currency_code` example, a list of codes). `ui/packages/i18n/src/currency.ts` is a comment-only change and carries no `@object-ui/i18n` changeset line; the changeset gates accepted that.

**Tests.** No test deleted. Three re-pins move the bare `fixed` case from accepted to refused (`field.test.ts` "should accept both currency modes", the factory test at `field.test.ts:1814`, `formula-currency-result.test.ts` malformed list); `field.test.ts` byte-exact empty-config output and `currency-precision-iso4217.test.ts` rows re-pinned to no `CNY`. New pins cover every claim in the brief's refusal and formula sections and the D2 entry's registration, retirement, D3 link, stored-row strip-and-keep, re-parse, idempotence and non-run on the authoring path. The one unpinned case is the stored `fixed` row WITHOUT a code above.

**JSON Schema projection.** The rule is value-conditional ("required when `currencyMode` is `'fixed'`"), which `refinement-projection.ts` names as the `if`/`then` shape that stays dropped (the `dependent-required` arm is presence-only), so the 13 new ledger sites are the sanctioned handling. The published `json-schema/**` and the generated form therefore accept `{ currencyMode: 'fixed' }` that the runtime refuses; a discriminated union over `currencyMode` would project exactly, and is a follow-up, not a block.

### ② Semver level

`minor` on `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/platform-objects`, each with the `**BREAKING**` banner and the `registered` ADR-0087 disposition — correct for a `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` change under the pre-GA level rule (ADR-0087, 2026-09-13 amendment: a metadata-facing retirement or break ships `minor`; an npm `major` is a planned act). The refusal names `@objectstack/spec 18`, which `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts` derives from `retiredAfter: '18.2.0'` being the newest published stable (label `18.2.0`), so the sentence and the pin agree. No `major` changeset is introduced.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **FAIL — the stored-row disposition rests on a false premise and the real disposition is undeclared.** `saveMetaItem` persists object rows verbatim (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, `resolveOverlaySchema` docblock), so a `fixed` row with no `defaultCurrency` can exist in `sys_metadata`; the changeset body, the D3 `reason` (`18.currency-config-fixed-default-currency-required.ts`), `default-changes.ts`, the registry docblock and `ui/packages/i18n/src/currency.ts` all state that every stored `fixed` row carries a code. Fix before landing: reword those five to the measured behaviour — such a row is registered unchanged with `_diagnostics` invalid and the `[metadata_spec_invalid]` boot line, its display is unchanged (the registry already held the raw body and every reader is mode-gated), a re-save is refused with the prescription, and `@objectstack/formula` reads a formula over it as unproven instead of fixed CNY — and pin it in `currency-config-dynamic-default-currency-removed.test.ts` (a stored row with `{ currencyMode: 'fixed' }` is left by the conversion and refused by `ObjectSchema.safeParse` at `fields.*.currencyConfig.defaultCurrency`). The code itself needs no change under ruling X; converting such a row to `'CNY'` would be the guess the ruling forbids.
- Dev flag "An authored `defaultCurrency` under `dynamic` is not refused": accepted; the order asked for no such narrowing, the conversion strips it only at rest, and the test pins it is returned as written.
- Dev flag "The refusal names `@objectstack/spec 18`": accepted, derived as in ② above. The same sentence cites "(ADR-0049)" for a ruling-driven narrowing (6464202770, principle #9689); not an enforce-or-remove retirement — a prose nit, fix with the FAIL item or leave.
- Dev flag "`ui/packages/i18n/src/currency.ts` changes a comment only, so no `@object-ui/i18n` changeset line": accepted; the gates accepted it and nothing published moves.
- Dev flag "The formula reader stops inferring a fixed CNY currency for a source field the schema now refuses; that field is itself refused at publish": accepted for authored sources; for a stored row it is the FAIL item's undeclared half.
- The dev-reported gate run (113/113, 0 NOT-MEASURED; dogfood 351 files, 2,804 passed on `5f876858f`) is the dev's own reading and is not re-run here. Check-runs on `c172c878ec`, read at 11:02Z, 11:08Z, 11:10Z and 11:13Z (62 runs at the last reading): completed success 36, among them the required contexts `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint UI` and `Build & E2E UI`, plus Check Changeset (11:01:08Z), Spec property liveness, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, Check Documentation Links, Flag docs affected by code changes, Plan Test Core shards, Build UI Deps, Build Docs, every `Lint ·` lane and `Type Check · source gates`, `· debt ledger`, `· consumer gates`, `· workspace`; skipped 7 (Dogfood Regression Gate shards, UI Published Artifacts, Dogfood Verify CLI, Temporal Conformance, 18.x upgrade harness, Schedule gate, Packed-tarball smoke); in_progress 19 at 11:13Z — the required `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core` (shards 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 still running; 2, 7, 8 success) and `Type Check UI`, and Test UI shards 1-4, 6-8, 10-12, 15, 16. No failure read at any of the four readings. An in_progress gate is a reading, not a pass; the verdict here does not rest on them.
